changes.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
changes.before: Huang issued an edict: “Feng Yu’s words frighten me.
changes.after: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.
changes.reason: English drops 乃令曰, 覽, and the title 封記室, reducing them to “Feng Yu’s words.”

changes.zh: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
changes.before: The heartland is still at war, so I cannot yet cut official posts.
changes.after: The heartland is not yet pacified, warfare does not cease, and meritorious service is already plentiful, so official posts cannot be reduced.
changes.reason: Omits 勳誠既多 and softens 官僚不可以減也.

changes.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
changes.before: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.
changes.after: For a minister to offer words that touch his ruler is most difficult; wild and baseless matters should all be brushed aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.
changes.reason: Paraphrase omits 關言於人主，至難也 and the full 妖妄…擇其善者而從之 structure.

changes.before: Restore censured advisers to their posts.
changes.after: They may all be restored to their original offices and still serve in the remonstrance bureau.
changes.reason: Omits 悉, 本官, and 仍居諫司.

changes.zh: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
changes.before: Award him fifty thousand cash and invite anyone, high or low, to criticize me freely.”
changes.after: So award him fifty thousand cash, and clearly announce inside and outside that whoever wishes to state my faults, whether noble or base, need have no taboo.”
changes.reason: Omits 明宣內外 and flattens 有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱.

changes.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
changes.before: Elated, he returned, proclaimed an amnesty, renamed the palace Helong, and built a Buddhist monastery on the height.
changes.after: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and built the Longxiang Buddhist monastery on the mountain.
changes.reason: Omits the temple name 龍翔 and softens 赦其境內 / 號新宮.

changes.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
changes.before: He wrote a primer to replace the Rush to Literacy and fifteen moral essays for the royal sons.
changes.after: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions to teach the sons of the nobility.
changes.reason: Omits the proper titles 《太上章》,《急就》, and 《典誡》.

changes.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
changes.before: Murong Ke seized Nansu from Goguryeo and left a garrison.
changes.after: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
changes.reason: Omits 而還 and the attack verb 攻.

changes.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
changes.before: In his third regnal year he sent Murong Jun and Murong Ke with seventeen thousand horse against Puyu; they captured the king and fifty thousand subjects.
changes.after: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
changes.reason: “His third regnal year” over-reads bare 三年; omits 東襲, 餘, and 以還.
